common_issues: Salt absent from every recipe — added 2g/serving (4g for 2-serve, 8g for 4-serve)
display_unit 'sprig' for curry leaves not in enum — converted to 'g'
All idli/dosa/uttapam batters missing fenugreek_seeds_raw (canonical for fermentation) and salt added before pouring — added
All dosa/uttapam recipes missing cooking fat (oil/ghee on tawa) — added groundnut_oil_raw
Ven pongal missing its defining ghee tempering with cumin, black pepper, ginger, cashew, asafoetida — reconstructed; vegan/nut_free/dairy_free tags removed; dairy and tree_nuts allergens added
Rava upma / poha upma / millet upma / vegetable rava upma missing mustard-urad-chana tempering in ghee — added; vegan and dairy_free tags removed where ghee added; dairy allergen added
Vegetable rava upma claimed 'Kharabath style' but missing tomato and kharabath/vangibath powder — name_alt simplified to 'Vegetable upma'
Millet upma alt-name 'Samai upma' refers to little millet, but ingredient is barnyard_millet — alt-name corrected to 'Kuthiraivali upma'
Prep_time 600min for fermented items is borderline; left as-is since it covers soak+ferment window approximately
